status: Proposed only. Nothing below has been implemented. Choose which items to implement before any change is made.

items.title: Add a live-rate tracker
items.detail: Record official hotel rates for the chosen dates on a schedule (date, time, total with taxes and fees, source URL). This is the only reliable way to find the cheapest booking time.

items.title: Add a travel-time matrix
items.detail: Compute door-to-door RTC transit times from each hotel to each restaurant and activity, using the official RTC trip planner. Replace the current property-level ranking with this matrix.

items.title: Make the ranking adjustable
items.detail: Add weights for price, location, amenities and Michelin count, so you can re-rank the hotels yourself.

items.title: Expand the hotel shortlist
items.detail: Add Mandalay Bay, Fontainebleau, Encore, Park MGM and downtown properties. Keep only resorts with official room pages.

items.title: Fill social links with verified handles
items.detail: Add TikTok, YouTube and Instagram handles from official websites only. Mark each handle with its source.

items.title: Add a link checker to the build
items.detail: Run an automated check on every external link before each deploy, so broken links are caught before publishing.

items.title: Add a 'days open' filter
items.detail: Let you filter restaurants and activities by the actual dates chosen (for example, Feb 15-18 2027).

items.title: Add a print and CSV export
items.detail: Export each table as CSV so the data can be shared or imported elsewhere.
